scope: Thirteen pending City of Albuquerque Municipal Development property fact sheets, reviewed as one set after direct official downloads and PDF or DOCX text extraction.
reason: Each record is an individual low-information real-estate fact sheet containing parcel identifiers, legal descriptions, acreage, and limited zoning or ownership data. None records a public project, disposition action, infrastructure plan, policy, or durable public-services information appropriate for ABQInfo.
